description_en: This Bhairava Temple is located in the open courtyard of Khapĩchẽ Ṭola, which lies to the east of the route from Saugal to Cyāsal Square. The main entrance of the temple faces west and is guarded by two stone lions. A colonnaded plinth can be found to the southern and western side of the temple, while the eastern wall is attached to aguṭhī-house. The building has balconies that face south and west, and a door on the first floor links theguṭhī-house to the neighbouring house. The temple has aphucāon top; this is crowned by a pinnacle.The main temple deity is Ākāśa Bhairava, though he is also referred to as Kāla Bhairava in an inscription of NS 802. Like other Bhairava temples of the valley, the temple is rectangular in shape. The carved entrance has two woodentoraṇasdisplaying images of Bhairava. Upon entering and ascending the L-shaped stone stairway, one reaches the sanctum. This is located on the first floor; it faces north and has a carved entry door with a tympanum which also contains an image of Bhairava. Inside the sanctum, one might notice that there is no statue of Bhairava. However, a painting of the deity that has been done on Nepali paper is stuck to the rear wall. The eight-handed blue Bhairava stands inpratyālīḍhaposture on top of abetāla. A metal mask of Bhairava's face can be found above the painting. The sanctum contains small niches worshipped as Nāsaḥdyaḥs that are covered with white cloth, and paintings of various gods have been made on the northern wall of the sanctum. Above these, one finds more woodentoraṇas. There is apuraon top of the temple's roof;this is reminiscent of the roof of abāhāḥor abahī. A finial flanked by two pairs of metal flags tops thepura.
description_ne: पाटनको खपिंछेँ टोलमा अवस्थित यी भैरवलाई टोलकै नामबाट खपिंछेँ भैरव भन्ने गरिन्छ । यिनलाई आकाश भैरव पनि भनिन्छ र मन्दिरमा नै रहेको नेसं ८०२ को अभिलेखमा यी भैरवलाई कालभैरव भनिएको छ । उपत्यकाका अन्य भैरव मन्दिर जस्तै यो मन्दिर पनि आयताकार छ । मन्दिर प्रवेश गर्ने सिँढीको दायाँ–बायाँ नेसं ८०२ मा स्थापित सिँहका मूर्तिहरू छन् । भुईंतलामा नभई मन्दिरको माथिल्लो तलामा गर्भगृह हुनुलाई यस मन्दिरको विशेषता मान्न सकिन्छ । मन्दिरको मूल प्रवेशद्वार हुँदै माथिल्लो तलामा पुग्न ढुङ्गाका सिँढीहरू बनाइएका छन् । माथिल्लो तलाको केन्द्र भागमा गर्भगृह छ जसको प्रवेश द्वारमा भैरवको मूर्ति कुँदिएको काष्ठतोरण राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहको दक्षिणी भित्तामा भैरवको पौभाःचित्र टाँसिएको छ । भैरव नील वर्णका, आठ हात भएका र बेतालमाथि प्रत्यालीढ आसनमा उभिएका छन् । यस पौभाःचित्रको ठिक माथि धातुबाट बनेको भैरवको मुखाकृति रहेको छ । गर्भगृहको पूर्वी भित्तामा नासःद्यःको रूपमा पूजिने खोपीहरू रहेका छन् । यी खोपीहरूलाई चित्र अङ्कित सेतो कपडाले छोपिएको छ भने खोपीमाथि काष्ठतोरण पनि चढाइएको छ । गर्भगृहका साथै यस तलाका अन्य भित्ताहरूमा विभिन्न देवीदेवताका मूर्ति तथा भित्तेचित्रहरू रहेका छन् । मन्दिरको छानामाथि बाहाबहीको छानामाथि जस्तै पुर बनाइएको छ र पुरमाथि छत्र सहितको गजुर एवं त्यसको दायाँबायाँ ४ वटा झण्डाहरू उभ्याइएका छन् । गजुरबाट पुरको तल्लो भागसम्म आइपुग्ने गरी तीनवटा पताःहरू लट्काइएका छन् ।यस भैरव मन्दिरको आफ्नै गुठी र मन्दिरप्राङ्गणमा एउटा गुठीघर पनि छ । गुठीले मन्दिरसँग सम्बन्धित पूजा, जात्रा एवं अन्य सांस्कृतिक कार्यहरू संचालन गर्दैआएको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Front yard of the temple was extended.

A gilt parasol (chatra) was offered to Bhairava by Krṣṇarāma Bhāro, Mādhavarāma Bharo, Manoharaĩha and others. The bottom of the inscription also informs the reader that thepurawas constructed on top of the temple at this time. In NS 795 the parasol was taken out from thepuraand reinstalled. Although it is mostly illegible, this inscription was published inH. Vajrācārya2000,132.
The text at the end of this inscription mentions that Jugideva Bhāvo and his sons offered Bhairava a male goat (bhairavasake thva khasi tayā juro). The meaning and context of the phrase is not clear.

historical_events.event_name: Construction of a pura on top of the roof
historical_events.event_description: After removing the old pinnacle, apurawas constructed on top of the roof by Devasĩha Bhāvo, Bijayasĩha Bhāvo and others Bhāvos.
Two stone statues of lions were installed in front of the main entrance by Mādhavarām Bhāvo, Jevanarāma Bhāvo and other Bhāvos.

historical_events.event_name: Formation of Caturdaśī Sevā Guṭhī and construction of a new building behind the temple
historical_events.event_description: Caturdaśī Sevā Guṭhī is aguṭhīwhich performspūjāto the Bhairava on the 14th day of the dark half of every month. At the same time as they were established, a new building was constructed behind the temple by the same group. This included members Jitrasĩha Prajāpati, Punasĩha, Dhantulimālasĩha, Devasĩha Bhāvo and others.
The monument was renovated by Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City and the local community.
